chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Sa'id ibn 'Uqda said: Narrated to us Muhammad ibn al-Mufadhdhal ibn Ibraheem ibn Qayss, and Sa'dan ibn Ishaq ibn Sa'id, and Ahmad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abd al-Malik, and Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn al-Hasan al-Qatawani, all of them said: Narrated to us al-Hasan ibn Mahboob, from Ibraheem ibn Ziyad al-Khariqi, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah: Abu Ja'far used to say: 'The Qa'im of the Family of Muhammad will have two occultations, one of which is longer than the other.' He said: 'Yes, and that will not be until the sword of the Banu Fulan disagrees, the circle tightens (hardship increases), al-Sufyani appears, the trial becomes severe, and death and killing encompass the people, in which they resort to the sanctum of Allah and the sanctum of His Messenger.'

key_terms.حَرَمِ رَسُولِهِ: The Sanctum of the Messenger (Prophet's Mosque)

ai.seo_question: What are the two occultations of the Imam of the Age and what signs precede them?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (as) validates the doctrine of the two occultations (al-Ghaybatan) of the Qa'im, distinguishing the shorter Minor Occultation from the longer Major Occultation. It highlights the eschatological context of the transition, marked by the rise of al-Sufyani, internal strife among the Umayyads ('Bani Fulan'), and widespread calamities that drive humanity to seek refuge in the sanctuaries of Allah and the Prophet.
